author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Tommy Hilfiger returned to New York Fashion Week on Thursday with a spring and summer 2027 show staged in the lobby of Manhattan’s Plaza Hotel.

Model Gigi Hadid opened the presentation, which featured oversized polo shirts, plaid bucket hats and a palette built around red, navy and other bold colors. Guests watched from green armchairs arranged through the hotel lobby, turning the landmark interior into part of the collection’s visual setting.

The location carried a personal connection for Hilfiger, who lived in a Plaza penthouse for more than a decade. Now 75, the designer founded his namesake brand in 1985 and said the label is continuing to pursue younger shoppers, including Generation Z. The company is owned by PVH.

Attendees included Kate Moss, Camila Cabello, Jisoo, New York Knicks players Karl-Anthony Towns and Josh Hart, and actor Patrick Schwarzenegger. The event took place on the first official day of the fashion-week calendar and used a familiar New York institution to frame Hilfiger’s latest take on American sportswear.
dek: The designer presented his spring and summer 2027 collection inside the Manhattan hotel, with Gigi Hadid opening the show.
headline: Tommy Hilfiger returns to New York Fashion Week at the Plaza
